title: Use arrow function to return a work order record
goal: An expression using an arrow function returns an object.
summary: When creating a work order, a new record needs to be generated with the passed in number and initial status.
tasks: Rewrite the starting statement into an arrow function named buildTicket.
returns { id, status: "Pending" }, id retains the incoming value and its type.

example.note: When returning an object directly, enclose the object literal in parentheses to distinguish it from the function body.

hint: You can also write return explicitly in the function body with curly braces.
